back: Any place or arrangement where buyers and sellers meet to exchange goods or services.
The quantity consumers are willing and able to buy at each price over a period.
The quantity producers are willing and able to sell at each price over a period.
The price at which quantity demanded equals quantity supplied.
Shortage: demand > supply (price below equilibrium, price rises). Surplus: supply > demand (price above equilibrium, price falls).
Income, prices of substitutes and complements, tastes and advertising, population, season.
Costs of production, weather, technology, number of producers, taxes and subsidies.

front: Effects of changes in demand and supply on price?
back: More demand: price up. Less demand: price down. More supply: price down. Less supply: price up.
